Created for lululemon's annual SeaWheeze collection, the Race Pace Print draws from the rhythm, movement, and collective energy of one of Vancouver's biggest running events. Developed in two colorways and applied across men's and women's run kits, the print was part of a limited-edition capsule released globally during the festival's virtual 2020 edition.
